editorial:
Imagine your life is a perfectly organized spreadsheet, and then Christmas happens. That is exactly where you find Michaela, a strict accountant who loves her lists. When her nephew needs help with a scrapbook for his mom who is serving overseas, she is paired up with Bryan, a relaxed and funny teacher. The chemistry between them is instant, and you will love watching Michaela slowly let go of her control as they go on wacky holiday dates to find the perfect memories. It feels like a warm hug and is the perfect kind of movie to put on when you just want to feel happy.

The acting is great and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling rushed. While the plot is a bit predictable, the sweet moments make it work. You might find some of the jokes a bit cheesy, but that is part of the charm. If you want a cozy night in, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great call so you can rewatch it every December.
endingExplained: In the end, Bryan gets a great job offer in another city, which puts Michaela in a tough spot. After a heartfelt talk with her nephew, she realizes that love is more important than a perfect plan. She runs to the airport and tells Bryan she wants to be with him. Instead of moving away, Bryan decides to stay in town for the right job and the right girl. They end the movie sharing a big kiss under the mistletoe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy holiday romances and happy endings.
